name: Embed Browser Games by Games I Know
author: gamesiknow

sections.description:
Embed Browser Games by Games I Know is a WordPress game plugin for adding interactive browser games to posts and pages. Embed games in WordPress using a Gutenberg block, a [gamesiknow] shortcode, or the built-in shortcode builder—no custom code needed.

What is Embed Browser Games by Games I Know?

Games I Know provides embeddable browser games such as Tic-Tac-Toe, Four-in-a-Row, Bingo, and I Know. This plugin adds a WordPress game widget that loads those games in a responsive iframe on your site.

Who is this plugin for?

  • Bloggers and publishers who want interactive content
  • Community and membership sites adding lightweight games
  • Marketers running engagement campaigns with embeddable games
  • WordPress users who prefer blocks or shortcodes over manual iframe code

Key features

  • Gutenberg block – Insert a game widget from the block inserter.
  • Shortcode – Use [gamesiknow] in posts, pages, and widgets.
  • Shortcode builder – Generate copy-ready embed code in wp-admin.
  • Responsive game widget – Control width, max width, alignment, radius, and shadow.
  • Safe iframe URLs – Embeds are limited to Games I Know endpoints.
  • Partner ID support – Connect site embeds to your Games I Know partner account.

Supported browser games

  • Tic-Tac-Toe (Player vs AI or PvP)
  • Four-in-a-Row
  • Bingo
  • I Know

How do I embed a game in WordPress?

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Add the Games I Know Game block, or paste a [gamesiknow] shortcode.
  3. Choose a game and layout options.
  4. Publish—the game loads on the frontend via a secure iframe from Games I Know.

External service

This plugin embeds browser games hosted by Games I Know. When a game is displayed, the visitor’s browser loads iframe content from gamesiknow.com. The iframe URL may include the selected game, Partner ID, source=wordpress, theme, mode, and campaign ID. Gameplay data is not stored in WordPress—only plugin settings are saved locally.

  • Privacy policy
  • Terms
  • Setup guide
  • Documentation

Translations

All user-facing strings use the gamesiknow-embed text domain. Contribute translations on WordPress.org to help international users find and use the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the gamesiknow-embed folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or upload the plugin ZIP from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Embed Browser Games by Games I Know from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Games I Know → Settings.
  4. Click Get Partner ID to sign in at Games I Know, then paste your Partner ID (optional but recommended).
  5. Add the Games I Know Game block to a post or page, or use [gamesiknow game="tic-tac-toe"].
sections.faq:
What is the Games I Know WordPress plugin used for?

It embeds browser games from Games I Know into WordPress pages using a block, shortcode, or admin shortcode builder.

Do I need a Partner ID?

No. Games work without one. A Partner ID links embeds on your site to your Games I Know partner account for tracking and setup.

How do I get a Partner ID?

Go to Games I Know → Settings in wp-admin and click Get Partner ID, or visit gamesiknow.com/partners/login/.

Can I embed games with a shortcode instead of the block?

Yes. Example: [gamesiknow game="tic-tac-toe"]. Optional attributes include width, height, theme, mode, and campaign_id.

Which games can I embed?

tic-tac-toe, four-in-a-row, bingo, and i-know.

Does this plugin store gameplay or visitor data in WordPress?

No. Only plugin settings are stored in WordPress. Gameplay runs inside a Games I Know iframe.

Is the plugin compatible with the block editor?

Yes. It includes a native Gutenberg block plus shortcode support for classic content areas.

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Yes. Contribute at the WordPress.org translate project for gamesiknow-embed.
